'''Keiichi Nakagawa''' (Japanese: '''中川慶一''' ''Nakagawa Keiichi'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Nakagawa was born on December 31, 1980 in {{wp|Shiga}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He began to provide voices for the {{pkmn|animated series}} in {{aniseries|SM}}, most notably voicing {{an|Professor Kukui}}, and later, [[Ash's Lycanroc]]. Following the death of fellow voice actor [[Unshō Ishizuka]] in 2018, Nakagawa temporarily took over the role of the [[narrator]] until he was replaced by [[Kenyu Horiuchi]] in October.
